page.title: calyr.aí engineering in action
page.description: An interactive calyr.aí story showing how observations become surrogate models, controllable predictions, and an engineered vascular result.

ui.default_hint: Use left/right arrows, the top buttons, or swipe horizontally on a phone.

slides.title: Complex Systems Hide Their Structure.
slides.subtitle: Observations simulations and constraints remain disconnected.
slides.story: Incomplete evidence reveals fragments of a system but not the organization that connects them.
slides.hint: Explore the isolated data spaces before a shared model exists.

slides.title: A Surrogate Creates a Shared Model.
slides.subtitle: Experimental and theoretical spaces become one representation.
slides.story: The surrogate learns a navigable model that connects observations simulation and domain knowledge.
slides.hint: Observe how the magenta surrogate aligns previously separate data spaces.

slides.title: Coupling Enables Prediction.
slides.subtitle: A change in one domain propagates through the model.
slides.story: Connected variables respond together so the system can predict consequences rather than evaluate isolated points.
slides.hint: Move a control point and watch the coupled representation adapt.

slides.title: Steering Enables Design.
slides.subtitle: Constraints become controls for valid solution spaces.
slides.story: Interactive boundary conditions guide exploration toward feasible high-value outcomes.
slides.hint: Adjust the magenta controls and steer the constrained solution space.

slides.title: Application: Patient-specific vascular design.
slides.subtitle: One surrogate produces an editable engineered result.
slides.story: The controlled representation converges into patient-specific vascular geometry while preserving evidence constraints and uncertainty.
slides.hint: Rotate the aortic arch and inspect the resulting medical geometry.
